name: Strategic & Operational Intelligence
description: Producing higher-level intelligence that informs organizational strategy, risk decisions, and operational planning. Covers threat landscape assessments, industry-specific threat briefings, geopolitical cyber risk analysis, trend forecasting, and translating threat intelligence into business risk language for executive and operational decision-makers.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to strategic or operational intelligence production

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the purpose and audience of strategic intelligence and how it differs from tactical products
evidence: Can explain the difference between strategic, operational, and tactical intelligence
Understands how threat intelligence informs business risk decisions
Aware of geopolitical factors that influence the cyber threat landscape

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Contributes research to strategic intelligence products under supervision
evidence: Researches industry-specific threats and contributes to landscape assessments under guidance
Assists in preparing threat briefing materials for operational or executive audiences
Tracks geopolitical events with potential cyber implications
Contributions reviewed by senior analyst before inclusion in products

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently produces operational intelligence and contributes substantively to strategic assessments
evidence: Authors operational threat assessments for engagement planning across 3+ cases
Produces industry-specific or sector-specific threat landscape reports
Translates technical threat intelligence into business risk language
Products pass senior analytical review and are accepted by stakeholders

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Produces strategic intelligence for executive audiences; leads threat landscape analysis
evidence: Authors strategic threat assessments consumed by executive leadership
Leads periodic threat landscape reviews and trend analysis
Integrates geopolitical, economic, and technical factors into threat forecasts
Mentors junior analysts on strategic thinking and executive communication

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines strategic intelligence program; recognized authority on threat landscape; trains teams
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's strategic intelligence program and methodology
Recognized as subject matter expert on threat landscape and forecasting
Publishes strategic assessments referenced by industry peers
Trains teams on strategic intelligence production and geopolitical cyber risk analysis

assessment_methods.description: Review strategic intelligence products for analytical depth, proper risk framing, source diversity, and executive-appropriate communication
Given a scenario involving geopolitical change, produce a strategic threat assessment covering implications for a specified industry sector

mitre_attack.note: Informs strategic threat assessments using ATT&CK-derived trend data
